name: Flyerimage
author: thousand31

sections.description:
Flyerimage is a powerful plugin for campaign managers, marketers, and content creators. It offers a centralized interface to manage:

  • Flyers and leaflets
  • Modal popups
  • Campaign materials

This plugin leverages modern frontend tools like Angular, Vue.js, TailwindCSS, Chart.js, and Trumbowyg. It integrates seamlessly with WordPress using the REST API and offers a clean user interface for organizing digital marketing assets.

Features

  • Campaign flyer and leaflet management
  • Modal popup management system
  • Custom UI via TailwindCSS
  • Developer-friendly architecture using Composer and PSR-4

Developer Setup

PHP Setup (Backend)

From the root directory:

`bash

composer install
`

Angular Setup (Frontend)

From the angular/ directory:

`bash

npm install
npm run build
`

Source Code for Minified Files

This plugin contains minified/compressed JavaScript and CSS files for performance optimization. The source code for all minified files is available in the following locations:

Minified Files Location

The following minified files are located in webapp/flyer-image-web/:
– main.*.js – Main application bundle
– polyfills.*.js – Browser compatibility polyfills
– runtime.*.js – Webpack runtime
– scripts.*.js – Third-party libraries (Trumbowyg editor)
– styles.*.css – Compiled styles

Source Code Repository

Primary Source: All source code is available in this plugin’s GitHub repository:
https://github.com/Thousand31/flyer-image-wp

Build Process

The minified files are generated using Angular CLI and Webpack:

  1. Frontend Source Location: angular/src/ directory contains all TypeScript, SCSS, and HTML source files
  2. Build Tool: Angular CLI with Webpack bundling
  3. Build Command: npm run build (from angular/ directory)
  4. Output: Compiled files are generated to webapp/flyer-image-web/

Third-Party Libraries

  • Trumbowyg Editor: Source available at https://github.com/Alex-D/Trumbowyg (MIT License)
  • Angular Framework: Source available at https://github.com/angular/angular (MIT License)
  • TailwindCSS: Source available at https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss (MIT License)

All third-party libraries used comply with GPL-compatible licenses.

License

Flyerimage is free software, licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

License URI

https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/flyerimage directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress plugin screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Flyerimage menu in the WordPress dashboard to begin managing your assets.
